notes: - **`band:<SYM>:<pe|ps>:<percentile>`** — the price implied by holding the multiple at a chosen percentile of its OWN trailing distribution, drawn through time on the price scale. Fundamentals come through the transform pipeline (true TTM EPS / TTM sales per share), so the bands inherit every honesty rule already in the machinery. The label discloses the multiple and the observation count; **fewer than 40 multiple observations is refused** — a band from thin history is a guess, and absence renders as absence. - **One-click band sets** in the Macro/Data panel: P/E bands and P/S bands (10/35/65/
